answer: Hi! I'm Matchly Assistant. I can help with jobs, applications, resumes, assessments, interviews, recruiter tools and account support.
Open Find Jobs from the candidate navigation. You can search published vacancies, review required skills and apply to a role that matches your profile.
Open a job listing, review its details and select Apply Now. You can check your application and its status from the Applications page.
Open Applications in your candidate dashboard to see each application's current status. Recruiter updates also appear in your notifications.
Open Resume and Edit from your candidate dashboard. Upload your resume and review the extracted profile details before saving.

Matchly compares your profile skills with a job's required skills. A match of 70% or more meets the current ATS shortlist threshold; the recruiter controls the next steps where a test is not configured.
Open the test invitation from Applications or use the test link sent to your registered email. Read the instructions, allow the required camera permission and complete the test before its expiry.
Try a current version of Chrome, allow camera access, close other apps using the camera and reopen the test link. If it still fails, raise a Technical Issue ticket here.
Scheduled recruiter meetings appear under Video Assessment in your candidate dashboard. Open the meeting card at the scheduled time and select Join Live Interview.
Recruiters can create a vacancy from Jobs and Applicants. Add the role details and required skills, then publish. An assessment question bank is optional and can be added later.
Open Hiring Board or Jobs and Applicants to review candidates, compare match scores, update application statuses, send tests and schedule interviews.

Recruiters can manage job-specific questions in Question Studio. Add MCQs manually or upload a supported CSV/XLSX file. Matchly can also suggest curated skill-based questions for recruiter review before approval.
Open Jobs and Applicants, find the candidate and select Schedule Meeting. Choose a title and date/time, then confirm. The candidate receives an in-app notification.
Check the notification area in your dashboard for application updates, assessment invitations and meeting notifications.
Use the email address and password registered with Matchly. If you cannot access your account, use Forgot Password on the login screen.
On the login screen, select Forgot Password, enter your registered email and follow the verification instructions to set a new password.
I can help create a support ticket. Sign in as a candidate or recruiter, then choose Raise a ticket in this chat. The Matchly admin team can review and reply.
You're welcome! If you need help with Matchly again, just open this assistant.
